name: Misono Chie
source:
She is the captain of the mama-san volleyball team and a reliable leader of the team. 

She is the mother of Nozomi, a mischievous adult woman who lives next door to the main character. She and Kaori have been best friends since childhood. She has known Kouta since he was born and loves him as if he were her own son.

She is like another mother to the main character. She is an experienced technician who can make a man's heart pound. She hopes to one day give the main character the best of all worlds.

[From [url=http://www.cattleyasoft.com/cat12/character.html]official site[/url]]
